title: Red Happy, Kid Ory and learning from Zutty
summary: Red Happy played with Kid Ory at the Pelican dance hall. Ory later told Watkins he reminded him of Henry Martin and Red Happy, and Watkins credits his fast beat to Zutty Singleton.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Right down in the pit, that's right down in the pit. Cause I had the first seat right up there by the pit, you know. I just leaned right on the rear like that and just looked right at him. And I used to go, that's where I used to sit all the time. I always made sure I got there early enough to get that seat. And that's where I used to sit and I used to watch him and I used to watch Red Happer there too. But I never seen Happer outside of the pit playing dance band. Oh yeah, when he was playing with Kid Horry. Oh yeah. He used to play with Kid Horry at the old Pelican dance hall, which was on Gravy near Rampart, right at the corner. Oh sure, I know. Yeah, right upstairs on the second floor. Yeah. Well that's the only dance place that I knew Red Happer to play with a band outside of the Lyrics Theatre with old man Joe Robe show. And he, he done some pretty good work. Cause when I was playing out at the Beverly Cabin before Ory, first time we went out there. And Ory came by to see us after we taken the job over, you know, because he was taking off for a while. I think he was going off somewhere, I'll just forget now. But anyhow, he came up and told me, say, you know, you remind me of Henry Martin and Red Happer. I said, I do. He said, yeah, you see, I like your style of playing. I said, well, I say, you know, I'm from the old Third Ward too. He said, you're from the Third Ward. I said, that's right, down in New Orleans. He said, I thought it was something mighty familiar about that beat you had there. But you see that beat I got, Bill, let me show you how some fellas, yes. You see, I learned from two or three different drummers. Now that beat I have, that fast tempo, I got that from Zutty Singleton.
I was going to ask if you saw Zutty, he used to beat the lyric too.
